en: Points of Controversy (Kathāvatthu),
Minor Section (Khuddakaaḍḍhapaṇṇāsaka),
Twenty-first Chapter.
Regarding the discourse on the Dispensation: Is the Dispensation something newly made?
Yes, it is.
"Are the foundations of mindfulness newly made?
"One should not say so...
[and so on] "...is the Dispensation newly made?"
“Yes.
Right efforts … [and so on] … bases of psychic power … [and so on] …
Are the faculties … the powers … the factors of enlightenment made new?
It should not be said thus … [as before] … Was unwholesome first and wholesome later performed?
It should not be said thus … [as before] …

"Was that which was previously subject to the outflows (*sāsava*), subject to fetters (*saṃyojaniya*), subject to ties (*ganthaniya*), subject to floods (*oghaniya*), subject to yokes (*yoganiya*), subject to hindrances (*nīvaraṇiya*), adhered to (*parāmaṭṭha*), subject to clinging (*upādāniya*), and subject to defilement (*saṅkilesiya*), later made free from defilement?
One should not say so... [and so on].
Is there anyone who makes new the teaching (*sāsana*) of the Tathāgata?"
“Yes.
[The opponent asks: “Is there anyone who produces something new in the foundations of mindfulness?
[The respondent replies: “One should certainly not say so…” [and so on].
Is there anyone [who has practiced] the right efforts …pe… the bases of psychic power …pe… the faculties …pe…?
If one says that [a person] creates something new through the powers... [and so on] ...up to the factors of enlightenment, one should not say so... [and so on].
Is there anyone who first performs what is unwholesome and later performs what is wholesome?
One should not say so... [and so on] ...

Is there anyone who first performs what is associated with the taints (*sāsava*)... [and so on] ... what is subject to defilement (*saṅkilesiya*), and later performs what is not subject to defilement (*asaṅkilesiya*)?
It should not be said thus … [as before] … Is it possible for the Tathāgata’s teaching to be made new again?
Yes, it is.
Is it possible to make the foundations of mindfulness new again?
One should not say so …pe… Is it possible to make the right efforts [new again]? …pe…
The bases of psychic power … the faculties … the powers … [and so forth] …
Can the factors of enlightenment (bojjhaṅga) be made anew?
One should not say so …pe… Is it possible to make what was previously unwholesome wholesome later?
It should not be said thus … [as before] … Is it possible to make what was previously associated with taints … [as before] … subject to defilement later become free from defilement?
It should not be said thus … [as before].
The Discussion on the Dispensation is finished.
